subtitle: AI-Native Developer Workflow: Using AI Tools Without Losing Control

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: AI coding tools can move quickly, but a vague request often turns into a vague implementation.

sections.heading: Workflow controls
bullets: Start with a concrete spec, not a vague coding request
Put reusable context in repository files, not only in chat
Ask the agent to plan before it edits

sections.heading: Reason
sections.body: Make AI-assisted work easier to review, test, debug, and ship.
